features.name: l2_norm_scaled
features.description: L2 norm of all features after dividing each by its training-set standard deviation, giving a scale-normalized distance from the origin
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a single scalar summarizing overall feature magnitude in a scale-invariant way, improving neighborhood geometry for KNN

features.name: cost_composite_scaled
features.description: Sum of buying and maint scaled by their standard deviations, representing total cost burden normalized for distance computation
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures combined cost signal in a scale-normalized form that reduces distortion in KNN distance calculations

features.name: utility_composite_scaled
features.description: Sum of persons, lug_boot, and safety scaled by their standard deviations, representing overall utility normalized for distance computation
features.expected_model_benefit: Aggregates utility-related features in scale-normalized form, improving KNN neighborhood separation between high and low utility cars

features.name: cost_utility_ratio
features.description: Ratio of scaled cost composite to scaled utility composite plus a small epsilon, capturing cost-to-utility trade-off
features.expected_model_benefit: Encodes the cost-utility trade-off as a single ratio feature that helps KNN distinguish value-for-money configurations

features.name: dist_to_low_cost_prototype
features.description: Euclidean distance from the row to an unsupervised low-cost prototype defined by minimum feature values (all zeros), scale-normalized
features.expected_model_benefit: Measures proximity to the cheapest/lowest-feature-value corner of the feature space, helping KNN identify extreme low-cost configurations

features.name: dist_to_high_value_prototype
features.description: Euclidean distance from the row to an unsupervised high-value prototype defined by maximum feature values (buying=0, maint=0, doors=3, persons=2, lug_boot=2, safety=2), scale-normalized
features.expected_model_benefit: Measures proximity to the high-utility, low-cost corner of the feature space, helping KNN identify desirable car configurations

features.name: dist_to_mean_prototype
features.description: Euclidean distance from the row to the training-set mean vector, scale-normalized using training standard deviations
features.expected_model_benefit: Measures how far a row is from the average car configuration, useful for KNN to identify outlier or typical configurations

features.name: safety_persons_interaction
features.description: Product of safety and persons features, capturing joint safety-capacity signal relevant to car desirability
features.expected_model_benefit: Encodes the interaction between safety and passenger capacity, which jointly determine desirability and help KNN find similar configurations

features.name: high_cost_low_utility_indicator
features.description: Binary indicator for rows where both buying and maint are above their means AND safety or persons is at minimum, flagging unfavorable configurations
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a cluster indicator for unfavorable car configurations, helping KNN group similar undesirable cars together

features.name: low_cost_high_utility_indicator
features.description: Binary indicator for rows where both buying and maint are below their means AND safety and persons are above their means, flagging favorable configurations
features.expected_model_benefit: Creates a cluster indicator for favorable car configurations, helping KNN group similar desirable cars together

features.name: overall_quality_score
features.description: Semantic assessment of overall car quality combining cost efficiency (low buying+maint), capacity (high persons), safety level, and luggage space into a holistic score from 0 (worst) to 10 (best)
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a human-interpretable quality score that compresses domain knowledge into a single dimension, improving KNN distance calculations by aligning feature space with perceived quality

features.name: feature_entropy_proxy
features.description: Variance-like spread of scaled features around their row mean, measuring how heterogeneous the feature profile is for a given car
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures within-row feature diversity; cars with uniform profiles cluster differently than those with mixed high/low features, improving KNN neighborhood geometry
